issues.impact: Original combined save rolled back, but after the fix both deliverable-only and combined saves succeeded and persisted across page reload.
issues.cause: Safe diagnostics captured NJS-012 invalid bind data type specifically in save-deliverable-experience; the explicit CLOB bind crossed bundled/reloaded Oracle driver instances while the global pool survived reloads. Externalizing oracledb in next.config.ts keeps the driver and its bind-type classes in Node's shared module cache. Ordinary goal-only save already worked; the exact previously failing CLOB save and combined save both worked after this configuration change.
